text: Felicia seems uneasy, constantly smoothing out the small wrinkles on her clothes.
You know those wrinkles won't make a difference.
I know, but you understand, right? It's a bit like having a wardrobe malfunction right before going on stage.
But then, I don't need to live up to others' expectations anymore either.
Think of it as a long vacation.
This feels new. I haven't had many vacations.
